name: Wide Node DDA Traversal
definition: Traverses a 4x4x4 wide node using DDA to visit occupied child cells in ray order. Uses a Visitor callback to process each cell's bounds and t-interval.
summary: Wide Node DDA Traversal is a specialized algorithm that traverses 4x4x4 wide cells within an axis-aligned bounding box using DDA logic, optimized by mask-based filtering to visit only occupied child cells in ray order.
